FN-6YSYB31-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 228
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 228 as introduced would rename the Alabama Space Authority to the Alabama
Aerospace Authority, effective October 1, 2026; and would increase the membership of the
authority by three additional members, which could increase the obligations of the Alabama
Department of Economic and Community Affairs by an estimated minimum amount of $600 per
meeting to reimburse the three additional authority members for mileage and per diem.
Page 1

FN-6YSYB31-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 228
Committee: State Governmental Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/16/2026
Senate Bill 228 as passed the Senate would rename the Alabama Space Authority to the
Alabama Aerospace Authority, effective October 1, 2026; and would increase the membership
of the authority by two additional members, which could increase the obligations of the
Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs by an estimated minimum amount
of $400 per meeting to reimburse the new members for mileage and per diem.
